component.name: SyncUp
component.summary: Safe Android photo/video backup and Takeout organizer

description.p: SyncUp backs up Android phones over MTP and organizes Google Takeout archives without deleting or replacing a destination until the new copy has been fully written and verified.

ul.li: Atomic, size-verified phone backups with resumable state.
Streamed Google Takeout ZIP processing without extractall().
Duplicate finder with preview, manifest, and undo.
